name: AWS Security Hub: Critical Finding RCA & Guarded Containment
description: Triggered by HIGH/CRITICAL AWS Security Hub ASFF findings across FSBP, CIS AWS Foundations, or Inspector/Macie integrations. Correlates the affected AWS resource ARN with recent CloudTrail configuration changes to determine root cause, gates automated resource remediation on human approval, and updates Security Hub workflow status.
author: AiSOC

steps.name: Fetch AWS Security Hub ASFF finding & resource configuration history
AI Root Cause Analysis: correlate Security Hub finding with CloudTrail change actor & exposure window

params.prompt: Apply automated AWS Config / Security Hub remediation on resource {{alert.resource_arn}}?

steps.name: Revert non-compliant resource configuration & mark Security Hub finding NOTIFIED
Notify Cloud SecOps with Security Hub RCA report

params.message_template: AWS Security Hub finding {{alert.title}} on {{alert.resource_arn}} triaged with AI RCA and remediated.

steps.name: Open AWS Security Hub RCA remediation ticket
